Privacy policy

Last updated: [DATE]

SideQuest is operated by [YOUR NAME OR BUSINESS], [COUNTRY]. Contact: [SUPPORT EMAIL].

What we collect

  • Account: your email address and a salted hash of your password.
  • Your workspace: the projects, ideas, steps, notes and income figures you enter.
  • Billing: if you subscribe, Stripe processes your payment. We store your Stripe customer and subscription IDs and status, never your card details.
  • Technical: server logs with IP addresses and request times, kept for security and troubleshooting for up to 30 days.

How we use it

To run the service, keep your account secure, process payments and answer support requests. We don’t sell your data, show ads, or use third-party analytics or tracking scripts. Your workspace content isn’t used to train AI models.

Who we share it with

Only providers needed to run SideQuest: hosting ([HOSTING PROVIDER]), payments (Stripe) and email delivery ([EMAIL PROVIDER]).

Cookies

One essential cookie keeps you signed in. There are no advertising or analytics cookies.

Your choices

You can export all your data from the app at any time and delete your account from the app footer. Deletion removes your account and workspace immediately; encrypted backups roll off within [30] days.

Changes

We’ll email you before material changes take effect.
